T: Two decades inside. One cold one on the roof.
D: A banker wrongly jailed for murder spends two decades in Shawshank, quietly keeping hope alive.
P: Pour the ginger beer when the tarring crew gets their cold ones on the roof.
S: Buttermilk cornbread baked in a hot pan.
Cornmeal, flour, buttermilk and butter baked in a hot pan at 210C for 20 minutes, cut into squares with butter.
Split peas simmered thick with a ham hock, ladled into tin bowls.

Soften the onion, carrot and celery in a splash of oil in a big pot. Add the split peas, ham hock, bay leaves and water and bring to the boil. Simmer gently, stirring now and then, until the peas collapse and the soup is thick. Lift out the hock, pull the meat off the bone, shred it and stir it back in. Season and ladle into bowls.
Prison library cheddar biscuits with chutney
Fluffy with vintage cheese and chives, split warm with butter and apple relish, for Andy's shelves.

Fluffy scones packed with vintage cheddar and chives, baked golden with a cheesy crust, split warm and served with butter and apple chutney. Heat the oven to 220C. Rub 60g cold butter into 375g self-raising flour with half a tsp salt. Stir in 120g grated vintage cheddar and 2 tbsp chives, then 250ml milk to a soft dough. Pat out 3cm thick and cut 10 rounds. Place close together on a lined tray, brush with milk and sprinkle with 30g more cheddar. Bake 15 minutes until risen and golden. Serve warm with butter and 150g apple chutney.
M: Beef chuck, potatoes and carrots slow-cooked in rich stock.

Beef chuck stewed with potatoes, carrots and onions in a thick gravy, ladled out with bread. Brown 1kg diced beef chuck in batches, then soften 2 onions. Return the beef with 2 tbsp flour, 750ml beef stock, 600g potatoes and 3 carrots in chunks. Cover and simmer 2 hours until tender. Ladle into bowls with thick white bread.
White fish, potato and onion in a milky chowder, saltine crackers on the tray.

Melt the butter and soften the onion. Stir in the flour for a minute. Whisk in the stock, add the potatoes and simmer until just tender. Pour in the milk, add the fish and simmer gently until it flakes. Season. Ladle into bowls with crackers on the side.
W: Milk chocolate with marshmallows, peanuts and broken cookies.

Milk chocolate melted with marshmallows, peanuts and broken biscuits, set in a tray and cut into rough rocks. Melt 400g milk chocolate gently. Stir in 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted peanuts and 100g broken plain biscuits. Spread into a lined 20cm tin, chill 2 hours until set and cut into rough rocks.
K: Ice-cold spicy ginger beer with fresh ginger coins and a squeeze of lime, in frosted glasses.

Ice-cold ginger beer with fresh lime and thin coins of ginger, poured into frosted glasses in the sun. Put 4 glasses in the freezer for 30 minutes. Slice a 3cm knob of ginger into thin coins and cut 2 limes into wedges. Fill each glass with 330ml cold ginger beer, squeeze in a lime wedge and add 2 ginger coins.
